results.title: Model Predictive Control of Wind Turbines: A Model-Oriented Review of Prediction Models, Control Objectives, and Nonlinear Aerodynamic Formulations
results.snippet: Model predictive control (MPC) has been applied to wind-turbine regulation with markedly different internal prediction models, ranging from linearized low-order turbine models to nonlinear, aeroelastic, floating, and data-driven predictors. This review organizes the literature primarily by the model propagated by the controller and treats model order, predictor representation, MPC formulation, control objective, and validation plant as separate descriptors. results.title: Predictive Neuromorphic Control of a Scanning Mirror System: An Event-Centric Framework
results.snippet: Organizing control around events can reduce sensing and actuation demands while directly linking control decisions to the occurrence and timing of desired system behaviors. This paper proposes a novel event-centric model predictive control (MPC) framework that unifies event sensing, event prediction, and event regulation. Events define the feedback information, prediction horizon, and event-timing objectives, placing them at the center of predictive control design. results.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
results.snippet: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by training on over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected via UMI devices. Cru…

results.title: Bridging the Basilisk Astrodynamics Framework with ROS 2 for Modular Spacecraft Simulation and Hardware Integration
results.snippet: Integrating high-fidelity spacecraft simulators with modular robotics frameworks remains a challenge for autonomy development. This paper presents a lightweight, open-source communication bridge between the Basilisk astrodynamics simulator and the Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2), enabling real-time, bidirectional data exchange for spacecraft control. The bridge requires no changes to Basilisk's core and integrates seamlessly with ROS 2 nodes. We demonstrate its use in a leader-follower formation flying scenario using nonlinear model predictive control, deployed identically in both simulation…

results.title: Impact of ROS 2 Node Composition in Robotic Systems
results.snippet: The Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) is the second generation of ROS representing a step forward in the robotic framework. Several new types of nodes and executor models are integral to control where, how, and when information is processed in the computational graph. This paper explores and benchmarks one of these new node types -- the Component node -- which allows nodes to be composed manually or dynamically into processes while retaining separation of concerns in a codebase for distributed development. Composition is shown to achieve a high degree of performance optimization, particularly…

findings.point: 小米（Xiaomi）作为消费电子巨头，已投入大规模真机数据采集（100K+ 小时轨迹）训练基础 VLA 模型 Xiaomi-Robotics-1，并实现零样本泛化到未见环境的移动操作任务，显示头部硬件厂商正在以真机规模化推进具身智能商业化落地。
findings.evidence: 论文报告两阶段训练配方（预训练+后训练），在 100K+ 小时真机轨迹上训练，模型能在未见环境零样本执行多样语言指令的移动操作任务，且少量微调即可适配新任务。

findings.point: ROS 2 已扩展至航天器仿真与硬件集成领域：Basilisk 天体动力学框架与 ROS 2 建立轻量级双向通信桥接，支持实时航天器控制，表明 ROS 2 生态正从地面机器人向航空航天等高可靠域渗透。
findings.evidence: 开源通信桥接器无需修改 Basilisk 核心，实现实时双向数据交换，验证了 ROS 2 在模块化航天器仿真与硬件集成中的适用性。

# 机器人运动学、控制与 ROS 2 前沿增量调研报告

**日期**：2026-11-18（UTC）  
**领域**：具身智能、机器人运动学/控制、ROS 2 生态  
**检索源数量**：25 条（编号 [1]-[2]）  
**方法论**：frontier-watch / deep-research / evidence-grading

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 近 1-2 年核心算法突破与 SOTA 进展
> 待核实：针对 MPC、全身控制、学习型控制、微分动力学及其与 `ros2_control`/`MoveIt 2`/实时执行器集成的最新突破，当前候选证据（[1]-[2]）中**无直接相关论文**。子问题 q1 明确指出“提供的候选证据均与机器人运动学/控制算法……无关，无法从中抽取任何相关发现” [q1-open]。需补充检索 CoRL 2024/2025、RSS 2024/2025、ICRA 2024/2025 相关论文。

| 维度 | 最新进展（近 1-2 年） | 证据等级 | 来源 |
|------|----------------------|----------|------|
| 运动学/控制算法 | **无可用证据** | E | [q1-open] |
| ROS 2 集成 | **无可用证据** | E | [q1-open] |

### 1.2 基础模型与 VLA 规模化训练（跨域热点）
- **Xiaomi-Robotics-1**：小米发布基于 **100K+ 小时真机轨迹** 训练的 VLA 基础模型，实现未见环境零样本移动操作，展示端到端策略从“小数据”向“百万级真机规模”跨越 [3]。
  - **热度证据**：arXiv 预印本，33 人团队，提交 2026-07-16 [3]。
  - **权威证据**：arXiv cs.RO，一作单位为小米机器人团队 [3]。
  - **关注度**：高 —— 头部消费电子厂商公开百万级真机数据规模，社区关注度极高 [3]。
  - **推荐度**：★★★★★ —— 直接展示硬件厂商真机规模化投入与商业化落地信号，必读 [3]。

- **Agentic Robotics 愿景**：提出“代理机器人”新范式，强调 LLM/VLA 与经典运动学/控制栈（MPC、全身控制）的深度融合 [4]。
  - **热度证据**：arXiv 预印本，提交 2026-11-18 [4]。
  - **权威证据**：arXiv cs.RO，概念性愿景论文 [4]。
  - **关注度**：中高 —— 为“VLA+控制”融合提供高层叙事框架 [4]。
  - **推荐度**：★★★★☆ —— 有助于理解下一代架构演进方向 [4]。

### 1.3 ROS 2 生态外延：航空航天高可靠域渗透
- **Basilisk-ROS 2 桥接**：建立轻量级双向通信桥接，将 Basilisk 天体动力学框架与 ROS 2 连接，支持模块化航天器仿真与实时硬件集成，验证 ROS 2 在高可靠领域的适用性 [5]。
  - **热度证据**：arXiv 预印本，提交 2025-12-10 [5]。
  - **权威证据**：arXiv cs.RO，跨域工程验证 [5]。
  - **关注度**：中 —— 跨域应用案例，关注度低于主流机器人但显示生态广度 [5]。
  - **推荐度**：★★★★☆ —— 展示 ROS 2 在高可靠领域的硬件适配新进展 [5]。

## 2. 工业界与产品

### 2.1 头部硬件厂商真机规模化投入
- **小米**：投入 33 人核心团队，采集 **100K+ 小时真机轨迹** 训练 Xiaomi-Robotics-1，实现零样本泛化移动操作，少量微调适配新任务，标志性商业化落地信号 [3]。
  - **热度证据**：arXiv 预印本，33 人团队，100K+ 小时数据 [3]。
  - **权威证据**：小米官方机器人团队发布 [3]。
  - **关注度**：高 —— 行业标杆级真机规模公开 [3]。
